checks.scope: Single-node retained-volume SIGKILL with fresh native DuckDB process per request; no persistent-session reconnect, physical power loss, S3 outage or multi-replica availability claim.

input.reader_access: alternate older seed IDs with most recently acknowledged live batch
input.arrival: closed loop per independent task; no retry; fresh native DuckDB C++ process per request
input.schema: Int64 event_id, Int32 customer_id, Int64 amount_cents, 64-character SHA256 String
input.body: customer=id%10000, amount=id%10000+1, payload=SHA256(decimal ID); no nulls/RNG
input.logical_seed_bytes_scope: fixed numeric widths and UTF-8 payload only; excludes wire and storage overhead

clickhouse.scope: Native cgroup CPU across all threads including probes; sampled charged memory and per-generation lifetime peak. Intervals use native /proc/uptime with centisecond resolution; full probe brackets retain uncertainty. Approximate du allocated bytes, not open-deleted or unique physical storage. Workload /results binds share one witness directory: do not sum them. Device I/O is Docker-VM accounting, not physical SSD latency/queue depth; do not sum stacked devices. Missing devices/counters are unavailable, not zero. CPU and byte/IOPS deltas exclude restart bridges and unobserved initial/final edges. Raw samples retain network counters and timing uncertainty.
clickhouse.memory_stat_scope: Sampled native cgroup byte gauges, not Go heap or process RSS. File includes charged file cache; kernel includes its subcategories. Counters are read nonatomically; do not infer an exact partition of memory.current.
